name: Raspberry Pi 5

outline.source: Raspberry Pi 5 mechanical drawing (Raspberry Pi Ltd); cross-checked 2026-10-02 against the official STEP: PCB slab 85 x 56, corner radius 3.0

pcb.source: measured from the official Raspberry Pi 5 STEP (RP-010083-CA, 'No Graphics small file', MIT licence, vendor-published without accuracy guarantee) with measure_reference_part on 2026-10-02: PCB slab solid 85 x 56 x 1.276 mm

mounting_holes.source: Raspberry Pi 5 mechanical drawing (Raspberry Pi Ltd): 3.5 mm from the edges, 58 x 49 mm pattern, hole 2.7 and pad 6 as drawn; cross-checked 2026-10-02 against the official STEP: 4 holes d2.7 at (3.5, 3.5), pattern 58 x 49

connectors.name: USB-C power input
connectors.source: measured from the official Raspberry Pi 5 STEP (RP-010083-CA, 'No Graphics small file', MIT licence, vendor-published without accuracy guarantee) with measure_reference_part on 2026-10-02: USB-C receptacle (insulator + shell), centre x 11.2
connectors.note: measured envelope of the receptacle solids in the official STEP; the plug size still comes from catalog.PLUG_DEFAULTS

connectors.name: micro-HDMI 0
connectors.source: port centre x = 25.8 mm as drawn (the Pi 4 value is 26.0); shell size from the receptacle datasheet
connectors.note: centre from the drawing; height 3.4 mm read from the side view, verify; cross-check 2026-10-02: the official 'No Graphics small file' STEP contains no micro-HDMI shell at this position, so the drawing-based centre stays

connectors.name: micro-HDMI 1
connectors.source: port centre x = 39.2 mm as drawn (the Pi 4 value is 39.5); shell size from the receptacle datasheet
connectors.note: centre from the drawing; height 3.4 mm read from the side view, verify; cross-check 2026-10-02: the official 'No Graphics small file' STEP contains no micro-HDMI shell at this position, so the drawing-based centre stays

connectors.name: Gigabit Ethernet (RJ45)
connectors.source: measured from the official Raspberry Pi 5 STEP (RP-010083-CA, 'No Graphics small file', MIT licence, vendor-published without accuracy guarantee) with measure_reference_part on 2026-10-02: the RJ45 jack (shell 21.6 x 15.9 mm, centre y 10.25, 3.05 mm past the edge); body length 21.6 mm identifies it (a USB-A stack is 17.5 mm long)
connectors.note: CORRECTION: the earlier data copied the Pi 4 layout (jack at y 45.75); the Pi 5 jack is at y 10.25, next to the USB-C end. The housing's solder tabs reach z -0.69 and are clipped to the PCB top

connectors.name: USB 3.0 stacked pair (blue)
connectors.source: measured from the official Raspberry Pi 5 STEP (RP-010083-CA, 'No Graphics small file', MIT licence, vendor-published without accuracy guarantee) with measure_reference_part on 2026-10-02: USB-A double stack, centre y 29.0, 14.5 wide, 17.5 tall
connectors.note: CORRECTION: the Pi 4 layout (centre y 27.0) does not apply. Position and size are measured; WHICH of the two stacks is USB 3.0 (blue) is not readable from the unnamed STEP solids and follows the Pi 4 order (USB 3.0 next to the Ethernet jack): unverified. Solder tabs (z -0.19) clipped to the PCB top

connectors.name: USB 2.0 stacked pair (black)
connectors.source: measured from the official Raspberry Pi 5 STEP (RP-010083-CA, 'No Graphics small file', MIT licence, vendor-published without accuracy guarantee) with measure_reference_part on 2026-10-02: USB-A double stack, centre y 47.0, 14.5 wide, 17.3 tall
connectors.note: CORRECTION: the Pi 4 layout (centre y 9.0) does not apply. Position and size are measured; WHICH stack is USB 2.0 (black) is not readable from the unnamed STEP solids (see usb3_pair): unverified. Solder tabs clipped to the PCB top

connectors.name: microSD card slot (underside)
connectors.source: socket on the underside of the board centred on the short edge; inserted card protrudes about 2.5 mm
connectors.note: card slot width and protrusion are approximate; cross-check 2026-10-02: the STEP socket sits under the board at y 22.1..34.1 (centre 28.1), the card protrusion is not modelled

connectors.name: 40-pin GPIO header
connectors.source: measured from the official Raspberry Pi 5 STEP (RP-010083-CA, 'No Graphics small file', MIT licence, vendor-published without accuracy guarantee) with measure_reference_part on 2026-10-02: 2 x 20 header body x 7.1..57.9, y 49.96..55.04, pins to z 9.85
connectors.note: no wall opening; the lid must clear it (keepout only)

omitted: power button, RTC battery, fan and UART connectors, PCIe and CSI / DSI ribbon connectors (internal, no wall opening unless the user needs them)
SoC heat spreader and any active cooler height
micro-HDMI shells are missing from the official STEP, so ports hdmi0 / hdmi1 stay drawing-based

step_cross_check.source: Raspberry Pi 5 official STEP RP-010083-CA (zip member rpi-5b_no_graphics.step)
step_cross_check.result: outline, corner radius and the 58 x 49 hole pattern agree with the drawing; PCB measures 1.276 mm; the Ethernet jack and the two USB stacks were NOT where the earlier Pi-4-derived data put them and are now measured
discrepancies: ethernet: y centre 10.25 measured vs 45.75 assumed (Pi 4 layout)
usb3_pair: y centre 29.0 measured vs 27.0 assumed
usb2_pair: y centre 47.0 measured vs 9.0 assumed
usb_c_power box y -1.2..6.12, z 0.31..4.57 measured vs y -0.5..6.9, z 1.4..4.6 community
hdmi0 / hdmi1: not modelled in the STEP, unchanged
